name: Chigusa Hatsumi
source:
The only daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url]'s foster parent, Viscount Chigusa, and the fiance of [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]the young man[/url]. From childhood, she was a sensible and cheerful girl, who interacted with [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]the protagonist[/url], who had lost his family and was adopted, without any biases.

Hatsumi developed feelings for [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] as she grew up beautiful and vigorous, so the two of them even became engaged. However, one night, she was brutally murdered in the city. And so the story of revenge begins, originating from her death.

[url=https://vndb.org/c48874]The protagonist[/url] continues to cherish her, his dearest and only beloved. Somehow, [url=https://vndb.org/c24964]Wild Dog Ichi[/url] closely resembles her.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
